summary: Acquired by **Black Box Intelligence (BBI)**, Apr 28, 2025. Yumpingo CEO George Wetz became GM of the business unit; the two had a formal partnership since 2022
BBI draws on a network of 120,000+ restaurant units
Real-time guest feedback and experience management (Europe, Australasia, US), now part of BBI's "AI Command Center" for restaurant leaders — "a single source of truth" (Mark Dillon, BBI CEO)
Not a loyalty engine; overlap with Genius Loyalty is limited to guest-insight use cases
Yumpingo markets dish-level guest surveys and feedback collection for restaurant operations. (Scope note: Undated page provides capabilities only; current customer count and outcomes remain open.)
